measures.title: Columbia County local homeowner's incentive adjustment program
measures.summary: A special election referendum under House Bill 439 and Chapter 89A of Title 36 of the Official Code of Georgia. It asks whether to establish a local homeowner's incentive adjustment program for Columbia County to reduce the tax burden on qualified homesteads in the county.
measures.yesMeans: A local homeowner's incentive adjustment program would be established for Columbia County to reduce the tax burden on qualified homesteads.
measures.noMeans: The program would not be established.
